items.title: Marian McPartland interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, April 26, 1997
items.q: He said the same thing and he left his horn on the kitchen table.

ctx.x: I like that phrase “arranger’s piano” actually. I think I’ll probably borrow that. It’s a compliment and it’s a qualifier too.

Well it’s sort of lets you know that it’s not an Oscar Peterson piano player. But nevertheless, Benny really played very well. And there’s other people you could qualify that way, like Gerry Mulligan. He’s another one and he definitely, I know he wanted to play the piano. He said the same thing and he left his horn on the kitchen table.
They probably wanted to get to play with you, you know, see what that felt like.
